name: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded: Polysomnographic Sleep Stage Benchmark
description: The Sleep-EDF Database Expanded contains 197 whole-night polysomnographic (PSG) recordings hosted on PhysioNet. Sourced from the Department of Clinical Neurophysiology at the Westeinde Hospital in The Hague and the University of Amsterdam, the collection includes two distinct studies: 153 recordings from 61 healthy subjects (Sleep Cassette Study) and 44 recordings from 22 patients with sleep initiation difficulty (Sleep Telemetry Study). Signal channels include horizontal EEG (Fpz-Cz and Pz-Oz), submental chin EMG, horizontal EOG, oral-nasal respiration, and rectal body temperature. Recordings are accompanied by manual hypnogram annotations scoring 30-second epochs into sleep stages (Wake, N1, N2, N3, N4, REM, and Movement) according to the Rechtschaffen and Kales standard.
